facts.text: I was looking to improve my online presence.
I attended a workshop on personal branding organized by the National Association of Women in Technology on February 27th.
The workshop took place at the Microsoft office.
I am interested in building a personal brand through content creation.
I want tips on creating engaging blog posts that showcase my expertise and attract the right audience.
I want specific ideas for repurposing blog posts into social media posts or email newsletters effectively.
I was thinking about creating a video series based on my blog posts.
I asked what equipment I need to get started with a video series.
I asked how the workshop was found and whether the speaker, Rachel Kim, was informative and engaging.
